info.name: Intervue AI - API (Production Grade)
info.description: Intervue AI API — full coverage: auth/RBAC, pipelines, jobs, snapshot workflow (Sprints 2–3), candidates/applications/invite tokens (Sprint 4), interview runtime/conversation/mock evaluation/decisions & overrides (Sprint 5), and the Internal capability surface for ai-service MCP tools (Phase 1). Folders 11+ chain collection variables; run in order. Internal folder requires internalServiceSecret from services/backend/.env.

item.name: 11 - Sprint 4: Candidates & Applications
item.description: Candidate identity, applications, invite tokens, candidate interview entry. No candidate account required.

item.name: 12 - Sprint 5: Interview Runtime
item.description: Interview session lifecycle: create, candidate access, start, answer, progression.

item.name: 13 - Sprint 5: Conversation
item.description: Conversation + messages runtime (foundation for the AI interviewer).

item.name: 14 - Sprint 5: Evaluation & Scoring (mock evaluator)
item.description: Current mock evaluator (length-based). Phase 4 replaces the engine with the two-model LLM pipeline over the same data model.

item.name: 15 - Sprint 5: Decisions & Overrides
item.description: One decision per application; human overrides preserve full history.

item.name: 16 - Internal API (ai-service capability surface)
item.description: Service-to-service API consumed by MCP tools (Phase 1). Auth: Authorization: Internal <INTERNAL_SERVICE_SECRET>. Raw payloads (no success/data envelope). Set internalServiceSecret in collection variables.
